name: AGS 2027 Annual Scientific Meeting
description: The AGS 2027 Annual Scientific Meeting is the yearly conference of the American Geriatrics Society, held at the Georgia World Congress Center in Atlanta, Georgia, with a pre conference day preceding the main program. The meeting covers clinical research, education, and quality improvement topics in geriatric medicine.
